name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart. I followed the vendor's instructions: the FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already exported in the environment, the OpenAI Python SDK was already installed, and I created a Python script using the OpenAI SDK pattern from the quickstart. The model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1` specified in the quickstart returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error, so I queried the available models endpoint (`https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models`) and used `accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b` instead. The script ran successfully and returned a chat completion: "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but this model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to query the models endpoint to find an available chat model and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b` to complete the quickstart.

friction.detail: The script using model accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1 crashes with openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}.

Trying accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct also yields openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}.

Agent had to run curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models | python3 -m json.tool | head -100 to discover a working model name not shown in the quickstart.
